title: 左连接
objective: 保留所有课程，为没有选课记录的课程显示未匹配的 NULL。
statement: 输出全部课程及其选课记录，依次为 course_id（courses.id）、course_name（courses.name）、enrollment_id（enrollments.id）。每条选课记录一行；没有选课记录的课程也输出一行，enrollment_id 为 SQL NULL。同名课程按编号区分，不要求行顺序。
knowledge: LEFT JOIN 保留左表所有行；存在匹配时输出匹配组合，不存在匹配时仍输出一行，并把右表列补为 NULL。
本关左表应是 courses；把 enrollments 放左边只能保留选课记录，不能表示完全没有选课记录的课程。
右表 enrollments.id 在原表不为空，但外连接生成的未匹配行可以让它变成 NULL。这是连接结果的空值，不是夹具中存在坏编号。
不要用 DISTINCT 合并同一课程的多条选课记录；左连接保证保留左行，并不保证每门课程恰好只有一行。
starterSql: -- 保留所有课程，为没有选课记录的课程显示未匹配的 NULL。

hints.text: 确定哪个实体即使没有匹配也必须出现，把它放左边。
FROM courses AS c LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e，ON 仍沿 course_id 外键。
SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, e.id AS enrollment_id FROM courses AS c LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, e.id AS enrollment_id FROM courses AS c LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON c.id = e.course_id;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 从 courses 左连接 enrollments，保留没有选课记录的课程，并将其 enrollment_id 显示为 NULL。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, e.id AS enrollment_id FROM courses AS c INNER JOIN enrollments AS e ON c.id = e.course_id;
SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, e.id AS enrollment_id FROM enrollments AS e LEFT JOIN courses AS c ON c.id = e.course_id;
SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, COALESCE(e.id, 0) AS enrollment_id FROM courses AS c LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON c.id = e.course_id;

flowchart.exampleSql: SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, e.id AS enrollment_id FROM courses AS c LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON c.id = e.course_id;

nodes.label: 左侧：所有课程
nodes.description: 以 courses 为保留侧，课程按编号区分，而不是按课程名合并。

nodes.label: ON：匹配选课课程编号
nodes.description: 查找 c.id = e.course_id 的选课记录；同一课程可以匹配多条选课记录。

nodes.label: LEFT JOIN：保留匹配或未匹配行
nodes.description: 有匹配时每条选课记录形成一行；无匹配时也保留该课程，右表列补为 NULL。

nodes.label: SELECT：输出三列
nodes.description: 取课程编号、课程名与选课记录编号；本例不筛选记录，也不保证行顺序。
